lines.en: label wakanadate15:
I tap on Wakana’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer-
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了 Wakana 的名字，等她接——

lines.en: Because, despite everything about her appearance screaming “I am going to stay in bed for the rest of forever,” she’s one of the only people I know who seems to always be doing something around this time.
lines.zh: 因为，尽管她那副样子从头到脚都在喊「我要永远躺在床上」，她却是我认识的人里唯一几个在这个点似乎总在干点什么的。

lines.en: So, based on prior experience, it’s probably safe to assume she’s either getting extra work done at school or...watching over the archery club (Again, at school.)
lines.zh: 所以根据以往经验，大概可以安全地假定她要么在学校加班，要么……在看着弓道社（再说一次，也在学校）。

lines.en: You know, she should probably just move closer to the school if she’s going to be spending practically all of her time there.
lines.zh: 说真的，既然她几乎所有时间都耗在那儿，她干脆搬到学校附近算了。

lines.en: : Good morning, Arakawa. What do you want?
lines.zh: : 早上好，荒川。你想干什么？

lines.en: : Just wanted to see what my favorite goth was up to.
lines.zh: : 只是想看看我最喜欢的哥特妹在忙什么。

lines.en: : If that section of your rolodex is comprised of more than just one person, please forward me their contact details. Talking to you and Imani is tiring. I need more people interested in incense.
lines.zh: : 如果你通讯录里那一栏不止一个人，请把他们的联系方式转发给我。跟你和 Imani 聊天太累人了。我需要更多对熏香感兴趣的人。

lines.en: : There’s always Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 不是还有 Nodoka 吗。

lines.en: : I said incense, not incest.
lines.zh: : 我说的是熏香，不是乱伦。

lines.en: : Sorry. Only one of those words is in my dictionary.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。这两个词里只有一个在我的词典里。

lines.en: : Then I believe it may be time for an upgrade. Fortunately for you, I’m currently surrounded by around a hundred of them.
lines.zh: : 那我觉得你该升级一下了。算你走运，我现在身边就围着上百本。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure to grab one on the way out so your wealth of knowledge can expand beyond the reach of whatever it is you do to your niece in your spare time.
lines.zh: : 我出门时一定拿一本，好让你的知识储备能扩展到「你闲暇时对侄女做的那些事」之外。

lines.en: : You too? I feel like I can’t talk to anyone nowadays without them suggesting something going on between Ami and me.
lines.zh: : 你也来？我感觉现在不管跟谁聊天，他们都要暗示我和 Ami 之间有点什么。

lines.en: : And whose fault is that, Arakawa?
lines.zh: : 那是谁的错呢，荒川？

lines.en: : Hers. Also, why not try spending a little time away from school every once in a while?
lines.zh: : 她的。还有，你为什么不偶尔试着离开学校待一会儿？

lines.en: : I get that you’re an intellectual and that libraries are like candy stores for you, but it’s still way too early in the morning to be going over there if you don’t have to.
lines.zh: : 我知道你是知识分子，图书馆对你来说就像糖果店，可要是没必要，现在这个点去那儿也太早了。

lines.en: : Are you done?
lines.zh: : 说完了吗？

lines.en: : I think so.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。

lines.en: : Good. Then I guess this is the part where I tell you I am not at school, you incorrigible half-wit. I’m at the public library. And you just lost your chance to obtain a new dictionary for free. I hope you’re happy.
lines.zh: : 好。那就到了我该告诉你「我不在学校」的部分了，你这不可救药的蠢货。我在市立图书馆。而你刚刚失去了免费拿一本新词典的机会。我希望你满意。

lines.en: : What are you doing at the library?
lines.zh: : 你在图书馆干什么？

lines.en: : Fucking reading, Arakawa. Do you even understand how libraries work?
lines.zh: : 他妈的看书啊，荒川。你到底懂不懂图书馆是干嘛的？

lines.en: : But why there? It’s nowhere near your apartment.
lines.zh: : 可为什么在那儿？那儿离你家可不近。

lines.en: : Hah...I’m doing research. And quite disheartened by the fact that you now know I am in a library and you refuse to hang up the phone.
lines.zh: : 哈……我在做研究。而且相当沮丧的是，你现在知道我在图书馆了，却不肯挂电话。

lines.en: : You haven’t hung up either. I just want to know-
lines.zh: : 你也没挂啊。我只是想知道——

lines.en: : If there’s something you want to know, you know where to find me. I don’t have time to “shoot the breeze” with you like this. I have work to do.
lines.zh: : 如果有你想知道的事，你知道去哪儿找我。我没空跟你这样「闲扯」。我有活要干。

lines.en: : Waka-
lines.zh: : Waka——

lines.en: scene black
Wakana hangs up the phone and I...guess I’m heading over to the public library to continue the conversation.
lines.zh: Wakana 挂了电话，我……想我是要去市立图书馆把话接着聊完。

lines.en: Not that I expect it to be exciting when she’s apparently just “researching” things, but at least deciding on this path for the day is easier than trying to uncover another one.
lines.zh: 倒不是指望会有多精彩——既然她显然只是在「研究」——但至少定下今天这条路线，比再去另找一条容易。

lines.en: I throw on my clothes and head over to the bus stop, patting myself on the back for deciding to visit a real adult woman.
lines.zh: 我套上衣服往公交站走，一边为自己决定去见一位真正的成年女性而暗自得意。

lines.en: A real adult woman with no inclination to have sex with me, yes. But a real adult woman nonetheless.
lines.zh: 是一位没有半点想跟我上床的意思的真正的成年女性，没错。但终究是位真正的成年女性。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary1
It takes me a few minutes to find Wakana once I get to the library, but I manage to spot her during my second lap around the place in what should have probably been the first section I checked.
lines.zh: 到了图书馆我花了几分钟才找到 Wakana，绕了第二圈才发现她，而且就在我本该第一个查的区域。

lines.en: I make my way through a narrow aisle walled by the names of dead poets and wind up in front of one still clinging to life by a few black threads dangling off the fingers of her gloves.
lines.zh: 我穿过一条由已故诗人姓氏砌成的狭窄过道，最后停在一位还靠手套指头上垂下的几根黑线勉强维系着生命的人面前。

lines.en: : Interesting. I didn’t think you were actually going to show up.
lines.zh: : 有意思。我没想到你真会来。

lines.en: : We weren’t done “shooting the breeze” yet.
lines.zh: : 我们那场「闲扯」还没扯完呢。

lines.en: : Unfortunately for you, I don’t have time to do much “shooting” at all. This is proving to be a bit more difficult than I expected.
lines.zh: : 你运气不好，我根本没空「扯」。这事比我想的要难一些。

lines.en: : What are you doing exactly? More...research or whatever?
lines.zh: : 你到底在干什么？又是……研究什么的？

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary2
: That is correct. Though, I suppose it’s less general research and more...brushing up on things I have forgotten.
lines.zh: : 没错。不过我想说，与其说是泛泛的研究，不如说是……把忘掉的东西重新捡起来。

lines.en: : Care to explain?
lines.zh: : 能解释一下吗？

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary3
: Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太想，不。

lines.en: : Wakana-
lines.zh: : Wakana——

lines.en: : Fine. If you must know, I have taken it upon myself to take on even more work- as the work I had already was apparently not enough for my masochistic brain.
lines.zh: : 好吧。你非要问的话，我又给自己揽了更多活——显然我原本那些活还喂不饱我那受虐狂的脑子。

lines.en: : I thought Osako was the masochist?
lines.zh: : 我以为受虐狂是 Osako？

lines.en: : Physically, yes. But the amount of pain I insist on putting myself through makes me feel as if I am some sort of mental masochist.
lines.zh: : 肉体上是。可我坚持让自己承受的痛苦量，让我觉得自己像是某种精神上的受虐狂。

lines.en: : And this additional work is?
lines.zh: : 那这份额外的工作是？

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary4
: I thought it might be fun to start an annual poetry contest for the girls at our school...as several of them have expressed interest in that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 我想给学校的女孩们办一场一年一度的诗歌比赛会挺有意思的……因为有几个似乎对这类事挺感兴趣。

lines.en: : But, me being me, simply agreeing to judge their work was not enough.
lines.zh: : 可我就是我，光是答应去评她们的作品还不够。

lines.en: : And so I find myself here, attempting to decipher several of the submitted works while brushing up on the fundamentals of what I’m trusted to be educating our students on.
lines.zh: : 于是我就到了这儿，一边试图解读几份来稿，一边重新温习那些我本该教给学生的基础知识。

lines.en: : I’d say something along the lines of, “The life of a teacher, right?” But I know that you wouldn’t be able to relate and I don’t want to confuse that tiny, pea-shaped brain of yours.
lines.zh: : 我本该说什么「当老师就是这样，对吧？」之类的话，可我知道你没法共鸣，我也不想去搅乱你那颗豌豆大的小脑子。

lines.en: : Interesting. I guess if anyone is going to judge something like that, it should be you.
lines.zh: : 有意思。我想如果要有人来评判这种东西，那确实该是你。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary5
: I’d say you’re just as qualified, but I suppose actually caring about the assignment is important too.
lines.zh: : 我想说你也同样够格，但我想「真正在乎这份作业」大概也很重要。

lines.en: : Is there some sort of theme everyone has to use?
lines.zh: : 有没有什么所有人都必须用的主题？

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary6
: Why? Are you thinking of entering?
lines.zh: : 怎么？你想投稿？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. Just a little curious, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 绝对没有。只是有点好奇，就这样。

lines.en: : Worried you’ll lose to a bunch of teenagers?
lines.zh: : 怕输给一群十几岁的小孩？

lines.en: : You got me. That’s exactly it.
lines.zh: : 被你说中了。就是这个。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary7
: The theme is Kumon-mi. Though, I’d implore you to use a pseudonym if you actually intend to submit anything.
lines.zh: : 主题是 Kumon-mi。不过，如果你真打算投什么，我建议你用笔名。

lines.en: : How that would work if you actually won, I have no clue. But I suppose that’s a bridge we don’t have to worry about crossing just yet.
lines.zh: : 万一你真赢了，那要怎么收场，我可没头绪。不过我想那是我们暂时还不必操心的桥。

lines.en: : Would you actually let me enter? Doesn’t that seem a little unfair?
lines.zh: : 你真会让我参赛吗？那不是有点不公平？

lines.en: : Perhaps. But I am rather curious about what sort of poem you’d be able to write, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 也许是。但我是挺好奇你能写出什么样的诗，荒川。

lines.en: : I doubt it would be anything good. There’s not much I really have to say about Kumon-mi other than it’s been really fucking hot lately.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑写不出什么好东西。关于 Kumon-mi 我真没什么可说的，除了最近热得要命。

lines.en: : Several of your students seem to have quite a bit to say, on the other hand. I’ve gotten more submissions from your class than my own, and I even offered extra credit for writing something.
lines.zh: : 反倒是你的几个学生似乎有挺多话要说。我收到的投稿里，你们班的比我自己的班还多，而我还加了学分才有人写。

lines.en: : From my class? Who?
lines.zh: : 我们班？谁？

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary6
: Would you like to read them together? You can...help me judge them.
lines.zh: : 要不要一起读？你可以……帮我评。

lines.en: : The way you said “judge” there makes me worry they aren’t going to be any good.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说「评」的那个语气，让我担心它们不会是什么好东西。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry too much. But I suppose I’ll let you get the final say.
lines.zh: : 我劝你别太担心。不过我想最终决定权可以交给你。

lines.en: scene black
Wakana bends down and removes a notebook from a large, purple bag.
lines.zh: Wakana 弯下腰，从一个紫色的大包里抽出一本笔记本。

lines.en: For anyone else, I’d use this opportunity to try and look up their skirt, but...yeah.
lines.zh: 换别人，我会趁机往裙底瞄一眼，可是……是啊。

lines.en: Not really possible when the girl I’m with insists on wearing a dress that reaches the floor on a day where you could cook an EGG by just cracking it open on the pavement.
lines.zh: 跟我来的这位姑娘非要在这么个把鸡蛋敲在人行道上都能煎熟的天里穿一条拖地长裙，那确实不太可能。

lines.en: scene tree3
scene wakanalibrary8
: So far, I’ve received submissions from a total of four of your girls. Though I believe there may be several others still working on theirs.
lines.zh: : 目前为止，我收到了你班上四个女孩的投稿。不过我想还有几个在写。

lines.en: : It’s unfortunate that Miyamura won’t be participating. I feel like she’d be good at this.
lines.zh: : 可惜宫村不参加。我觉得她会很擅长这个。

lines.en: : She seems like more of an intellectual than an artist to me.
lines.zh: : 她给我的感觉更像是学者，而不是艺术家。

lines.en: : Fair point. What we do have so far isn’t all that bad, however. Well, with the exception of one poem that I believe was created just to irritate me.
lines.zh: : 有道理。不过我们目前收到的还不算太糟。嗯，除了有一首我觉得纯粹是为了气我而写的。

lines.en: : Why? Does it talk about how life is awesome and totally worth living?
lines.zh: : 怎么？它讲的是人生多美好、多值得活下去？

lines.en: : No. But it does mention an ungodly desire to strip the clothes from my body and “taste every inch of me,” but it’s disguised as a poem about dragonfruit.
lines.zh: : 不是。但它确实提到了一种想把我的衣服剥光、「品尝我的每一寸」的亵渎欲望，而它伪装成了一首关于火龙果的诗。

lines.en: : I’d actually be quite impressed if I wasn’t so appalled by the subject matter- which has absolutely nothing to do with Kumon-mi, by the way.
lines.zh: : 要不是我对题材这么反感，我大概会挺佩服的——顺便说一句，这跟 Kumon-mi 八竿子打不着。

lines.en: : Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？

lines.en: : Who else would write a poem about tasting every inch of me?
lines.zh: : 除了她，还有谁会写诗说要品尝我的每一寸？

lines.en: : Honestly? Probably a few more of my girls.
lines.zh: : 说实话？我班上大概还有几个。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary9
: Really? Huh.
lines.zh: : 真的？呵。

lines.en: : And here I was beginning to think I had already lost my girlish charm.
lines.zh: : 我还以为我的少女魅力早就没了呢。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if your “girlish charm” is what they admire.
lines.zh: : 我不确定她们欣赏的是不是你的「少女魅力」。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary8
: Regardless, that was Nagasawa’s disqualified submission. But the three that remain are much better.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，那是长泽被取消资格的作品。但剩下的三首好多了。

lines.en: : This one comes from...Fukuyama.
lines.zh: : 这首来自……福山。

lines.en: : The town that I grew up in;\nWhere I still grow today.
lines.zh:
: 我长大的那座小镇；
到今天我仍在长大。

lines.en: : Where skies are blue and grass is green and everything’s okay.
lines.zh: : 那儿天空蔚蓝、青草碧绿，一切都好。

lines.en: : The town where all my friends live;\nAnd where I fell in love.
lines.zh:
: 我所有朋友住的小镇；
也是我坠入爱河的地方。

lines.en: : It may not be exciting, but it’s the only town I love.
lines.zh: : 它也许不精彩，但它是我唯一爱的小镇。

lines.en: : She rhymed “love” with “love.”
lines.zh: : 她把「爱」跟「爱」押了韵。

lines.en: : She rhymed “love” with “love...”
lines.zh: : 她把「爱」跟「爱」押了韵……

lines.en: : And while that’s not unheard of and could be intentional, I’m almost certain it was an accident and that she’s going to realize her mistake and try to correct it.
lines.zh: : 虽然这并非前所未闻，也可能是有意为之，但我几乎可以肯定是失误，而且她早晚会发现这个错、试图改掉。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, the rules state that as soon as something is submitted, you can’t get it back.
lines.zh: : 可惜规则规定，一经提交就取不回来。

lines.en: : Who’s next? There are two more, right?
lines.zh: : 下一个是谁？还有两首，对吧？

lines.en: : Up next is...oh. The one I tried to pawn off on you only to find that she’s been “in love” with you since she was a child- Nakayama. How fun.
lines.zh: : 接下来是……哦。那个我本来想推给你的、结果发现她从小时候起就「爱」着你的——中山。真有意思。

lines.en: : No blindeyes bloom on paths I walk, but I found a shepherd’s purse;
lines.zh: : 我走过的小径上，盲眼花并未绽放，我却寻见一株荠菜；

lines.en: : With pockets full of buttercups, I returned it to the earth.
lines.zh: : 口袋里装满毛茛，我把它送回了大地。

lines.en: : Now in its place, a pasture- cross the homes of hyacinth.
lines.zh: : 如今取而代之的是一片牧场——越过风信子的居所。

lines.en: : Near a suckling clover fountain and its bitter orange drip.
lines.zh: : 紧挨着一座哺育三叶草的喷泉，和它苦涩的橙色滴落。

lines.en: : That one doesn’t seem to have anything to do with Kumon-mi either.
lines.zh: : 这首看起来也跟 Kumon-mi 没什么关系。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary9
: Ah, but that’s where you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 啊，这你可就错了。

lines.en: : Nakayama comes from the old district, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 中山来自老城区，对吧？

lines.en: : She does, but I don’t really understand how that’s relevant here.
lines.zh: : 是，但我不太明白这跟这儿有什么关系。

lines.en: : It’s a poem about the Hamori River...and all of the flowers that bloom there.
lines.zh: : 这是一首关于羽森川的诗……以及那儿盛开的所有花。

lines.en: : I needed to do a little research to confirm, but I thought I understood it after my first read as Osako and I have walked along that path before. It’s beautiful.
lines.zh: : 我查了点资料才确认，但第一遍读的时候我就觉得读懂了，因为我和 Osako 以前走过那条路。它很美。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary10
: Or was. I hear that area’s all but abandoned now. Shame.
lines.zh: : 或者说，曾经很美。我听说那片地方现在基本都荒废了。可惜。

lines.en: : It used to be so lively there.
lines.zh: : 那儿以前热闹得很。

lines.en: : Huh...
: I didn’t realize Noriko could write like that.
lines.zh: : 我没想到 Noriko 能写出这种东西。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary11
: I agree. Her submission is probably my favorite of what I’ve received so far. But the biggest surprise of all is this next one.
lines.zh: : 我同意。她的投稿大概是目前我收到的里我最喜欢的。但最大的惊喜是下面这首。

lines.en: : From Ami Arakawa...
lines.zh: : 来自荒川 Ami……

lines.en: : Summer. Winter. Paradox. No autumn, nor a spring;
lines.zh: : 夏。冬。悖论。没有秋，也没有春；

lines.en: : At night, I watch the sakura peel themselves off thick, red strings.
lines.zh: : 夜里，我看着樱花从粗粗的红线上把自己剥落。

lines.en: : Why can I see what isn’t there? Why can’t I feel the sting?
lines.zh: : 为什么我能看见不存在的东西？为什么我感觉不到刺痛？

lines.en: : Of the town that took the world away and the evil song it sings.
lines.zh: : 属于那座夺走了整个世界的城镇，和它唱的那首邪恶的歌。

lines.en: : I don’t believe I’ve grasped the full meaning of the poem yet, but this...longing for pain and how it ties in with our missing seasons...
lines.zh: : 我想我还没完全把握这首诗的意思，但这种……对痛苦的渴望，以及它跟我们缺失的季节之间的联系……

lines.en: : It reminds me of another poet I used to follow when I was younger.
lines.zh: : 它让我想起一个我年轻时追过的诗人。

lines.en: : One that, if what I’ve heard is true...was also born and raised here.
lines.zh: : 一个如果我所听说的属实……也在这里出生、长大的人。

lines.en: : It’s impossible to tell for sure, though, as she always used a pseudonym.
lines.zh: : 不过没法确认，因为她一直用笔名。

lines.en: : The girl who cannot breathe...
lines.zh: : 无法呼吸的女孩……

lines.en: : Infamous for her self-destructive thoughts on what it means to be and the use of themes that most others would-
lines.zh: : 因她对「存在意味着什么」的自我毁灭式思考、以及使用大多数人都不会——的主题而臭名昭著。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary12
Uh-oh!
lines.zh: 噢——糟了！

lines.en: It looks like you might have remembered something!
lines.zh: 看来你可能想起了什么！

lines.en: Remembering things is bad! Remember to remember that!
lines.zh: 想起事情是坏事！记住要记住这一点！

lines.en: If you remember too much, you won’t be able to put your meat stick inside of tight meat holes anymore.
lines.zh: 要是你想起的太多，你就再也没法把你的肉棍塞进紧致的肉洞里了。

lines.en: And that’s the point! Remember? Remember? Remember?
lines.zh: 而那才是重点！记得吗？记得吗？记得吗？

lines.en: This is all just a game! It’s all part of a game!
lines.zh: 这一切都只是一场游戏！都是游戏的一部分！

lines.en: It’s not real at all! Nothing is real! Nothing is real!
lines.zh: 根本不是真的！什么都不是真的！什么都不是真的！

lines.en: scene black
but if that’s true, why is everything so much bigger than you?
lines.zh: 可如果那是真的，为什么一切都比你大那么多？

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary12
: Ara...kawa?...
: Let’s get out of here.
lines.zh: : 我们离开这儿。

lines.en: : What?...
: You. Me. Let’s leave.
lines.zh: : 你。我。我们走。

lines.en: : Do something else.
lines.zh: : 干点别的。

lines.en: : Something better than this.
lines.zh: : 比这更好的事。

lines.en: : Bigger.
lines.zh: : 更大的事。

lines.en: : Let’s leave.
lines.zh: : 我们走。

lines.en: : Arakawa...
lines.zh: : 荒川……

lines.en: : Your eyes...
lines.zh: : 你的眼睛……

lines.en: : Don’t look at me.
lines.zh: : 别看我。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary13
: You’re making that quite hard with how close you’ve decided to come all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 你突然靠这么近，让我很难办啊……

lines.en: : I’m flattered, really. Though, I’m not quite sure this is the type of relationship where you’re allowed to pin me against the wall and tell me to “get out of here” with you.
lines.zh: : 我受宠若惊，真的。不过我不太确定我们这种关系允许你把我按在墙上、叫你「离开这里」。

lines.en: : Let alone in broad daylight...in the middle of a public library.
lines.zh: : 更别提还是在大白天……在图书馆正中央。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary14
: Um...Miss, are you okay? Do you need me to...call for help?
lines.zh: : 呃……小姐，你还好吗？需要我……叫人帮忙吗？

lines.en: : Just a minor lover’s quarrel. Apologies for the commotion.
lines.zh: : 只是小小的情侣拌嘴。抱歉吵到你们了。

lines.en: : Oh...Okay...
: Well...uhh...I guess let me know if you need anything?...
lines.zh: : 那……呃……需要什么就说一声？……

lines.en: : Understood. Thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 明白。非常感谢。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary15
: If you have something to say, say it. This isn’t exactly a comfortable position for me.
lines.zh: : 如果你有话要说，就说。这个姿势对我来说可不太舒服。

lines.en: : I can make it more comfortable if you want.
lines.zh: : 我可以让它更舒服一点，如果你愿意的话。

lines.en: : Oh?
: Is that what we’d do if I left with you?
lines.zh: : 如果我跟你走，我们要做的就是那个？

lines.en: : Do you want to have sex with me, Arakawa?
lines.zh: : 你想跟我上床吗，荒川？

lines.en: : Is that why you’re cornering me like this?
lines.zh: : 你这样把我逼到角落里，是为了这个？

lines.en: : Or is there perhaps another reason?
lines.zh: : 或者也许有别的原因？

lines.en: : One you’re not telling me about, maybe?
lines.zh: : 一个你没告诉我的原因，也许？

lines.en: : You-
: If you expect me to be afraid of you, it’s not going to happen. You look fucking pathetic right now.
lines.zh: : 如果你指望我会怕你，那是不可能的。你现在的样子真是他妈的可怜。

lines.en: : Don’t...
: Don’t talk...
: About...
: Don’t talk about what? I don’t know what to do if-
lines.zh: : 别谈什么？我不知道该怎么——

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary16
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Arakawa, what was the last thing I said before you decided to be a big, scary man and pin me to the wall?
lines.zh: : 荒川，在你决定当个又大又吓人的男人、把我按在墙上之前，我说的最后一句话是什么？

lines.en: : Tell me.
lines.zh: : 告诉我。

lines.en: : You can’t...can you?
lines.zh: : 你说不出来……对吧？

lines.en: : You know-
lines.zh: : 你知道——

lines.en: : I don’t know anything.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不知道。

lines.en: : Your eyes say otherwise.
lines.zh: : 你的眼睛可不是这么说的。

lines.en: : I told you to stop looking at them.
lines.zh: : 我叫你别看它们。

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary17
: Fine. But if you seize this opportunity to stick your tongue down my throat, I have a hard time seeing how this friendship is going to work out.
lines.zh: : 行。但如果你趁机把舌头伸进我嘴里，我看不出这友谊还能怎么继续下去。

lines.en: : You can stay like this for as long as you need to...until you start to collect yourself, but...
lines.zh: : 你想这样待多久都行……直到你缓过来，不过……

lines.en: scene wakanalibrary18
: Just watch your fucking step, okay?
lines.zh: : 只管他妈的注意点你的分寸，好吗？

lines.en: : This little...show you’re putting on right now? Not a fan.
lines.zh: : 你现在演的这一出……小把戏？我不喜欢。

lines.en: : I doubt my girlfriend would be much of a fan either.
lines.zh: : 我想我女朋友也不会喜欢。

lines.en: : Arakawa...
lines.zh: : 荒川……

lines.en: : What?...
scene wakanalibrary19
: Just thought I’d say...
lines.zh: : 只是想说……

lines.en: : You’re a lot uglier up close.
lines.zh: : 你近距离看丑多了。

lines.en: scene black
The rest of the day disappears once you let her go...along with the three poems and the words uttered thereafter.
lines.zh: 你一松开她，这天剩下的时间就消失了……连同那三首诗和之后说出的话。

lines.en: But you know they’re still in there somewhere.
lines.zh: 但你知道它们还在里面某个地方。

lines.en: Hiding somewhere you can’t see.
lines.zh: 藏在你看不见的地方。

lines.en: Waiting for the chance to suffocate you.
lines.zh: 等着有机会把你闷死。

lines.en: You try to masturbate when you get into bed, but it doesn’t get hard.
lines.zh: 你上床后想自慰，但它硬不起来。

lines.en: $ wakanadate15 = True
Wakana’s affection does not rise.
lines.zh: Wakana 的好感度没有上升。

lines.en: But she saw who you really are today.
lines.zh: 但她今天看见了真正的你。
